name: trailing-spaces
description: Highlight trailing spaces and delete them in a flash!
readme:
# Trailing Spaces

Delete trailing spaces from the whole file or only from the lines you changed since the last save, by command or automatically on save.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version.

## Commands

- **Trailing Spaces: Delete**: removes trailing spaces from the whole file.
- **Trailing Spaces: Delete - Modified Lines Only**: touches only the lines that differ from the file on disk. The comparison does not use git, so it works the same inside and outside a repository.

Set `trailing-spaces.trimOnSave` to clean the file on every save.

## Not in Diode yet

Trailing spaces are not highlighted in the text: Diode does not paint text decorations from extensions yet.

works: Trailing Spaces: Delete and Delete - Modified Lines Only
Trimming on save with trailing-spaces.trimOnSave, undo brings the spaces back
limits: Trailing spaces are not highlighted in the text: Diode does not paint text decorations from extensions yet, so the Highlight command and the backgroundColor and borderColor settings have no visible effect
